name: binomial_moderate_asymptotic
description: Two-sample comparison p0=0.20 vs p1=0.30, alpha=0.05 two-sided, 80% power, equal allocation. Expected counts are adequate, so AUTO uses the pooled normal approximation; minimal n0=n1=295 (total 590); n0=294 (294+294=588) gives 0.79956 and fails. Note: the analytic value is a fixed-SE approximation; exact enumeration of the random-denominator score statistic and Monte-Carlo evidence are checked separately in tests.

reference.provenance: Direct normal tail evaluation with n1 derived from n0, independently of ssp.kernels
